newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek business expectations index rises in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Greek business expectations index rises in Sept.

text.p: The Greek industry's expectations on aggregate demand, production and inventories rose in September compared to July, the private Foundation for Economic and Industrial Research (IOBE) said in its monthly bulletin.
The business expectations index reflects the industry's outlook on aggregate demand, production and inventory levels for the next three to four months from the month that the index was calculated.
No figures are available for August.
